_about: Gemma 4 26B-A4B partner with a persona and memories (2026-10-22): g26 (run 12's recipe) plus ~280 new calls where the prompt says who the friend is and what it remembers about the caller. Each call has its own made-up friend and caller: some bring up a memory, some leave them alone, some have no memories at all, and in about half the caller claims a shared past that is not in the memories (the friend does not play along; those replies weigh like a warning). A judge drops written calls where the friend invents a past. The old calls keep the plain partner prompt, so no memories still means no shared past. Partner calls now open with a friend's greeting instead of 'How can I help?', and the help-desk greetings of the mixed-in older calls are not trained on (g26 said 'What can I help you with?' to break a silence).
name: g26m
